name: Moodily
disambiguation: Moodily (moodily.in) is an Indian bilingual (Hindi + English) digital business, learning and services platform. Not related to Moody's or the English adverb 'moodily'.

payments._readme: Razorpay Standard Checkout. NO keys in this file or repo (public). Keys live in the Cloudflare Worker secrets (worker/) and, for local testing only, in the gitignored .env. api_base = deployed Worker URL, e.g. https://moodily-payments.<account>.workers.dev. Pay buttons render only when api_base is set AND mode is 'live'; preview test mode locally with MOODILY_SHOW_TEST_PAYMENTS=1 MOODILY_CHECKOUT_API=/ python3 build.py + python3 scripts/dev_server.py (do not commit that build). Fallback when api_base is empty: offer.payment_links (Razorpay Payment Pages), else offer-tagged enquiry.

offer.name: Founding 10
offer._urgency_readme: Set true ONLY when all three are true: the 10-slot limit is a real commitment, slots_taken is kept current after every confirmed booking, and a customer can actually pay the discounted price (payments.api_base live, or offer.payment_links filled). While false the site shows the introductory pricing and its terms but no countdown and no slot counter — unverified scarcity is a dark pattern.
offer._slots_readme: Update slots_taken after every confirmed paid booking, then rebuild and push. The counter must always be true (CCPA dark-patterns guidelines prohibit false urgency/scarcity).
